title: Travel Man promotional side panel
slide_intent: Keep the programme visible while giving viewers a clear action they can take.
strategic_value: The gradient side panel can carry Channel 4 attribution and a streaming invitation without interrupting Travel Man footage.
demonstration: A travel montage gains a right-hand gradient panel; the green 4 gives way to Travel Man: 96 Hours in Rio and Stream now.
practical_value: Choose a supporting panel that accommodates the call to action while leaving most footage visible.

content_islands.name: Programme montage
content_islands.spec: Use the wide left region for Rio locations and the presenters.

content_islands.name: Information panel
content_islands.spec: Introduce the narrow right panel with the mark, then retain title and streaming action.

reference_purposes.Application: The film applies a gradient side panel to a Travel Man promotion.
